dataset: Swiss Dwellings v3.0.0 (Archilyse AG), https://zenodo.org/records/7788422, CC BY 4.0. Only aggregate results are stored here.
procedure: scripts/swiss_calibrate.py (pre-registered in its docstring): real rule functions r_room_min_area / r_room_min_width on residential apartments rotated to their dominant wall direction; gate >= 90 % quiet; seeded defects (bedroom 7.0 m2, living room 2.0 m across) must be caught.
flag_causes: genuinely small rooms (about 2.03 m wide, 7.2 m2): below the single-bedroom minimum
open-plan dining ZONES labelled as separate areas (4.7-5.4 m2): the rule judges a zone as a room - known limit, not amended post hoc

margins.note: thresholds sit just below the real 1st percentile: they bite in the tail, they are not vacuous

limits: the double-bedroom minimum (11.5 m2 / 2.55-2.75 m) is not tested: the data do not say which bedrooms are doubles
wet-stack and area-schedule checks are not tested here
